facts.fact: 新来的 Elara 告诉 Aiden，她刚签下买下 inn 的最终合同，打算重开。
facts.anchor: I just signed the final contracts to buy the inn

facts.fact: Elara 说长期计划是把 inn 改造成提供瑜伽与辅助疗法的养生度假地。
facts.anchor: my plan is to turn it into a wellness retreat

facts.fact: Elara 把重开派对定在这个周末，因为那时樱花最好。
facts.anchor: that’s when the cherry blossoms will be at their best

facts.fact: Jamie 说 inn 空置多年像蒙着裹尸布沉睡，现在正在醒来。
facts.anchor: it was like it was asleep under a shroud – but now it’s waking up again

facts.fact: Katie 讲 Jamie 小时候放学迷路、打电话说街道在他周围重排的故事，话被 Jamie 打断。
facts.anchor: the streets were reordering themselves around him

facts.fact: 饭桌上大家突然沉默，Amrita 察觉自己错过了某件事却不知道是什么。
facts.anchor: It was clear to Amrita that she’d missed something

facts.fact: Amrita 说 Lily-Ann 做的花束维持了三周还很好看。
facts.anchor: they looked amazing for at least three weeks

facts.fact: Jamie 看着 Amrita 与 Mia、Katie 说笑，认定她也已经是家人。
Jamie 想必须找到办法让魔法允许他把真相告诉 Amrita。
facts.anchor: He’d have to find a way to make the magic let him tell her

facts.fact: Amrita 发现 Jamie 在衣柜与抽屉里给她腾出空间，问他是不是在「给她一个抽屉」。
facts.anchor: are you giving me a drawer
